overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals considered several residential and commercial variance and special permit applications. The board approved multiple petitions—including a height variance for a commercial research facility and various residential alterations—while denying a two-family conversion and continuing two cases.

items.title: 120 Winthrop Street
items.summary: The board continued the fence variance petition to March 28, 2024, at the applicant's request.

items.title: 290 Salem Street
items.summary: The board voted to continue the petition for dimensional and use variances for a proposed seven-unit mixed-use building to March 28, 2024, to allow the applicant to refine plans with the Community Development Board.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street
items.summary: The board approved a use variance to convert the existing structure into a two-family dwelling.

items.title: 694 Winthrop Street
items.summary: The board approved a variance for an eight-foot fence in the rear yard but denied the request for an eight-foot fence along the right side yard.

items.title: 85 Morton Avenue
items.summary: The board granted a special permit allowing a second-story addition and conversion of the single-family house into a two-family dwelling.

items.title: 65 Burgett Avenue
items.summary: The board denied a use variance to convert a single-family house to a two-family dwelling due to a lack of demonstrated statutory hardship.

items.title: 48-64 Commercial Street
items.summary: The board approved a height variance allowing a 46.5-foot-tall research and testing laboratory building in an industrial district.

items.title: 75 Bristol Road
items.summary: The board approved a variance allowing the construction of a full third floor on a single-family residence.

items.title: 9 Lincoln Street
items.summary: The board granted a special permit to convert an existing attached garage into finished living space.

items.title: 129 Forest Street
items.summary: The board granted a variance to construct a second egress deck two feet from the front property line on a corner lot.
